purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian consignment promissory note (Nota Promissória Consignação) printing/reporting system, likely for a retail or wholesale distribution company using consignment sales with promissory notes
purpose.summary: This program generates printed promissory notes (Notas Promissórias) for consignment transactions. It reads CGI form input parameters (client range, document number range, emission date range), queries indexed work files, and produces formatted output documents with customer details, values, and dates. It supports multiple copies (vias) of each document.
